description.narrative: The proposed financing consists of three separate loans for three renewable energy projects (two wind farms and a solar plant with a total capacity of more than 600 MW) developed and built by Enel S.p.A. ("Enel") through its Mexican renewable energy subsidiary, Enel Rinnovabile S.A. de C.V. ("Enel Rinnovabile"). The projects include the Dolores Wind Farm Project in Nuevo León ("Dolores"), the Amistad IV Wind Farm Project in Coahuila ("Amistad"), and the Magdalena Solar Project in Tlaxcala ("Magdalena", which together with Dolores and Amistad are referred to as the "Portfolio Projects"). The estimated total cost of the three projects is approximately USD 700 million.The financing consists of a total aggregate amount of USD 150 million, provided by IDB Invest with a bullet repayment after seven years, and will be jointly and severally guaranteed by Enel.
